name: Oats Chilla
steps: Whisk oat flour, curd, measured water and salt to a smooth, thick batter. Rest 10 minutes so the oat flour hydrates instead of forming dry pockets on the griddle.
Grate carrot and finely chop onion, chilli and coriander. Fold them and cumin into the batter; add a tablespoon of water only if it no longer spreads with a spoon.
Heat a lightly oiled flat griddle over medium heat. Spoon one-eighth of the batter into a medium round and spread gently to about 5 mm thick.
Cook 2–3 minutes until the base is golden and the edges look set. Turn and cook a further 2 minutes until the middle is firm and the vegetables are tender.
Make eight chillas, using the measured oil a little at a time. Serve two per person with green chutney while warm.
tips: Oat batter thickens as it rests; adjust only at cooking time.
passiveTime: Rest the oat batter for 10 minutes.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
